newsitem.title: USA: United Security sees Q3 above expectations.
newsitem.headline: United Security sees Q3 above expectations.

text.p: United Security Bancorp said on Wednesday its third quarter results continue to be stronger than originally expected, based on the performance of all its units during July and August.

"The company's net income of about $2.6 million for the first eight months of 1996 was nearly 53 percent higher than the $1.7 million earned from operations in the year-ago period," said William Dashiell, United Security president and chief executive officer.
The year-ago net figure includes a $651,000 gain.
"Results remain extremely favorable -- with assets, loans, deposits and stockholders' equity all continuing their positive upward trends," Dashiell said.
United Security's assets totaled $226.9 million as of August 31, up from $191.8 million at December 31, 1995. Loans totaled $172.5 million on August 31 and deposits were $193.7 million.
